lines: Peene waalo, suno
couplets.en: Drinkers, lend an ear.

lines: Peene waalo, suno, na chhupa kar piyo
couplets.en: Listen, drinkers, let your drinking be out in the open.

lines: Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo
couplets.en: For once, mix love with wine and drink.

lines: Peene waalo, suno, na chhupa kar piyo

lines: Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo
couplets.en: For once, mix love with wine and drink.

lines: Tum kahoge, ye kaise mumkin hai yaar?
couplets.en: How could that be, my friend, you will ask.

lines: Saamne tum sanam ko bitha kar piyo
couplets.en: Sit your beloved across from you and drink.

lines: Aur nazar se nazar phir mila kar piyo
couplets.en: Then meet their gaze and drink.

lines: Kabhi ishq aur sharaab ko mila kar piyo
couplets.en: For once, mix love with wine and drink.

lines: Jab chhalakte hain jaam, leke dilbar ka naam
couplets.en: When the cups brim over as you speak your beloved's name.

lines: To rangeen hoti hai aur shaam
couplets.en: The evening takes on a deeper colour.

lines: Jab jawaani pe ho mai-kashi ka ye daur
couplets.en: When this season of wine comes in the bloom of youth.

lines: To maza aashiqi ka aata hai yaar
couplets.en: Then, my friend, you learn how sweet it is to be in love.

lines: Aur is daur mein sab bhula kar piyo
couplets.en: In this season, let everything slip from mind and drink.

couplets.en: For once, mix love with wine and drink.

lines: Jab piyoge kabhi jaise kehte hain hum
couplets.en: When you drink one day as I have said.

lines: To mit jaayenge saare dard aur gham
couplets.en: All your pain and sorrow will fade.

lines: Jab behak jaayenge had se zyaada qadam
couplets.en: When your steps falter and carry you too far.

lines: To sambhaalega tumko tumhaara sanam
couplets.en: Your beloved will be there to steady you.

lines: Dar hai kis baat ka, sar utha kar piyo
couplets.en: What is there to fear, drink with your head held high.
